pineios_emsr692_enhanced.label: Run 1: Pineios / Storm Daniel (EMSR692) enhanced, model_author_ref
log_boundary_lines: Warning! Boundary cells found in mask without boundary points from bnd file. Setting water level at 0.0 m at mask boundary cells.

nan_is_dry_check.rule: zs is NaN where the cell is dry: at the first output time (zsini=0) the finite msk==1 cells must be exactly the msk==1 cells with zb<0

zs_wet_cell_mean_series_m.note: argmin/argmax return the earliest time when the series is constant
argmin/argmax return the earliest time when the series is constant

matching.method: nearest forcing-grid node to each msk==2 cell centre; both datasets are in the same projected CRS (forcing file stored by HydroMT in the model EPSG), so no reprojection was needed

constants.note: sfincs.inp rhow=1024 (model) vs rho=1025 used here as specified

comparison.evidence: all 650 msk==2 cells have zb = 0.0 m and zs = NaN (dry) at all 193 hourly outputs; zsmax NaN in all 5200 cell-windows (never wet within any dtmaxout = 86400 s window). The imposed boundary level therefore never exceeded 0.0 m, while the IB expected at the MSLP minimum is 0.102 m (rel. first step) / 0.055 m (rel. 1013.25 hPa).
